description: One card in the middle of a flat page, with an optional heading and background image. The layout embedded builds carry, and the one every theme starts as.

link_color.title: Links
link_color.description: Sign up, forgot password, footer links.

background.title: Page background
background.description: Behind everything. Also seen while a page background image loads.

card_background.title: Card background
card_background.description: The card, or the form panel.

card_border.title: Card border
card_border.description: Used only when the card border width is not 0.

input_border.title: Input border
input_border.description: Text fields, selects and outlined buttons.

font_family.title: Font
font_family.description: A CSS font stack, without quotes: Inter, system-ui, sans-serif. To load a web font, add an @import line at the very top of the stylesheet.

font_size.title: Base font size
font_size.description: A CSS length; 15px or 1rem. Everything scales from it.

card_radius.title: Card corner radius
card_radius.description: A CSS length; 0 for square corners.

control_radius.title: Control corner radius
control_radius.description: Buttons and inputs. A CSS length; 999px for pills.

logo_height.title: Logo height
logo_height.description: A CSS length; the logo scales to it and keeps its proportions.

logo_align.title: Logo and heading alignment
logo_align.description: Inside the card or form panel.

main_logo.title: Logo
main_logo.description: An asset URL such as /assets/logo.png. PNG or SVG with transparency, at least twice the logo height.

favicon.title: Favicon
favicon.description: An asset URL; 32×32 PNG or an SVG. Empty keeps the layout’s own.

page_background_image.title: Page background image
page_background_image.description: Optional, behind the card; scaled and cropped to the window. 1920×1080 or larger, under 1 MB.

heading.title: Heading
heading.description: Above the form. Empty for none.

subheading.title: Subheading
subheading.description: Under the heading. Empty for none.

help_text.title: Help text
help_text.description: A line under the form, such as where to get help. Empty for none.

footer_text.title: Footer text
footer_text.description: One line at the bottom of the page. Empty for none.

identifier_label.title: Identifier field label
identifier_label.description: The first field on an identifier-first sign-in. Empty keeps the label the sign-in service chooses (E-mail address, Username, or both).

not_you_label.title: Not you? link
not_you_label.description: Shown under the identifier once it is known; starts again with another.

provider_button_prefix.title: Provider button prefix
provider_button_prefix.description: Before the provider’s name: "Continue with" Google. Google and Apple allow only "Continue with", "Sign in with" or "Sign up with", or the same in the page’s language.

google_button_theme.title: Google button colours
google_button_theme.description: Google’s three: light is white with a grey border, dark is near-black, neutral is light grey with no border.

apple_button_style.title: Apple button style
apple_button_style.description: Apple’s three: black, white, or white with a black outline. Use white or outline on a dark background.

signup_prompt.title: Sign-up prompt
signup_prompt.description: Shown when sign-up is allowed, before the sign-up link.

login_prompt.title: Back-to-sign-in prompt
login_prompt.description: On the sign-up form, before the sign-in link.

forgot_password_label.title: Forgot-password link
forgot_password_label.description: Under the password field, where the realm offers self-service reset.

reset_request_sent.title: Reset request: sent
reset_request_sent.description: Shown after every request, whether or not an account matched; it must not say which.

reset_request_unavailable.title: Reset request: not offered
reset_request_unavailable.description: When the realm does not offer self-service reset.

recovery_request_throttled.title: Reset request: too many requests
recovery_request_throttled.description: When a request limit refused the reset request; nothing was sent. {time} is the wait (retry_minutes, retry_seconds).

retry_second.title: Wait: one second
retry_second.description: The {time} in a “try again in” line, under a minute, when it is one second.

retry_seconds.title: Wait: seconds
retry_seconds.description: The {time} in a “try again in” line, under a minute. {n} is the number.

retry_minute.title: Wait: one minute
retry_minute.description: The {time} in a “try again in” line, when it rounds up to one minute.

retry_minutes.title: Wait: minutes
retry_minutes.description: The {time} in a “try again in” line, in whole minutes rounded up. {n} is the number.

verification_sent.title: Sign-up: confirm your address
verification_sent.description: After a sign-up the realm holds until the address is confirmed.

verify_email_done.title: Confirm address: confirmed
verify_email_done.description: Before the address that was confirmed.

invite_skip_label.title: Invitation: skip the password
invite_skip_label.description: Where a password is optional, beside the password form.

invite_link_done.title: Invitation: accepted without a password
invite_link_done.description: Before the link on to sign in.

magic_link_sent_code_body.title: Magic link: sent text, code only
magic_link_sent_code_body.description: For a realm that e-mails a code and no link. Before the masked address.

magic_link_unknown_address.title: Magic link: no account
magic_link_unknown_address.description: Under the e-mail field when the provider is set to tell and the address has no account. Before the address.

magic_link_throttled.title: Magic link: too many requests
magic_link_throttled.description: When a request limit refused the request or the resend; nothing was sent. {time} is the wait (retry_minutes, retry_seconds).

magic_link_restart_label.title: Magic link: change address link
magic_link_restart_label.description: Beside the resend link, after a link or code was sent. Goes back to the e-mail field.

magic_link_landing_failed.title: Magic link: link refused
magic_link_landing_failed.description: When the link is opened somewhere it was not asked for, or has expired.

magic_link_consumed_elsewhere.title: Magic link: signed in elsewhere
magic_link_consumed_elsewhere.description: On the code screen, when the link was confirmed in another browser. This browser stays signed out.

magic_link_confirm_before.title: Magic link: confirm, before the address
magic_link_confirm_before.description: A link opened in a browser other than the one that asked for it. Before the masked address.

magic_link_confirm_after.title: Magic link: confirm, after the address

magic_link_continue_before.title: Magic link: continue to the app
magic_link_continue_before.description: After confirming, when the sign-in came from an app. Before the app’s name.

magic_link_account_label.title: Magic link: go to the account page
magic_link_account_label.description: Beside the continue link after confirming.

bot_challenge_unavailable.title: Bot check: could not load
bot_challenge_unavailable.description: Beside sign-up, magic link and resend on a realm with bot protection on, when the check cannot be shown.

remember_device_label.title: Second step: remember this device
remember_device_label.description: The box that skips the second step on this browser next time, when the sign-in allows it.

factor_redirect.title: Second step: leaving for the provider
factor_redirect.description: Shown for the moment before the browser goes to Duo or another provider’s page.

stylesheetAttributes.font_family: Inter, system-ui, -apple-system, Segoe UI, Roboto, sans-serif

content.heading: Sign in
content.reset_request_help: Enter the username you sign in with and we’ll e-mail you a link to choose a new password.
content.reset_request_sent: If an account matches, we’ve sent a link to its e-mail address. It expires soon, so use it shortly. If nothing arrives, check your spam folder or ask your administrator.
content.reset_request_unavailable: Password reset is not available here. Ask your administrator.
content.recovery_request_throttled: Too many reset requests. Try again in {time}.
content.verification_sent: Check your e-mail. We’ve sent a link to confirm your address; open it, then sign in.
content.invite_skip_label: Skip — I’ll sign in with e-mail links
content.invite_link_done: You’re set — sign in with an e-mail link.
content.magic_link_sent_body: If an account can sign in with it, we sent a link to
content.magic_link_sent_code_body: If an account can sign in with it, we sent a code to
content.magic_link_code_prompt: Or enter the code from the e-mail.
content.magic_link_throttled: Too many sign-in e-mails. Try again in {time}.
content.magic_link_landing_failed: This link only works in the browser where you requested it. Enter the code from the e-mail there instead.
content.magic_link_consumed_elsewhere: You signed in on another device.
content.bot_challenge_unavailable: We couldn’t load the check that keeps this form safe. Reload the page to try again.
content.factor_enroll_required: This account needs a second step to sign in. Choose one to set up now.
content.factor_denied: None of the sign-in methods on this account can be used here. Contact your administrator.
content.factor_spent: That method cannot be used right now. Choose another.
content.factor_redirect: Taking you to finish this step…
content.webauthn_enroll_label: Set up a passkey or security key
content.webauthn_label: Use your passkey or security key
content.webauthn_dismissed: Nothing was used. Try again when you are ready.
content.webauthn_unsupported: This browser cannot use passkeys or security keys. Choose another method.
content.recovery_offer_enrolled: Recovery codes sign you in if you lose your other method. Each works once.
content.recovery_offer_low: Recovery codes left on this account:
content.recovery_confirm_needed: Confirm that you have saved the codes to continue.
